name: K3s
description: K3s is a lightweight, fully conformant Kubernetes distribution in a single binary. This VM runs a server node ready to join agents.

notes.text: Default settings use Debian 13; choose another Debian/Ubuntu cloud image in Advanced settings. Cloud-Init uses the shared credentials/network wizard and is enabled by default for unattended runs. Explicitly disabling it on Debian uses a nocloud image with root console login and no password; set a password immediately.

K3s and Helm are installed into the image before import. k9s is added from the derailed/k9s release when available. Optional ArgoCD bootstrap runs on first boot through argocd-bootstrap.service; monitor journalctl -u argocd-bootstrap -f.
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
